interpretation.plain_speak: With no refreshes, the hand is a literal countdown. Starting at any tested hand position, each new admission evicts exactly the next slot in cyclic order, and after 16 admissions every original fact is gone.
interpretation.north_star_question: Turns replacement trajectory into an explicit native failure forecast under the simplest frozen condition. The next question is whether that forecast remains accurate when bounded refresh events change ages.
interpretation.next_stage: introduce a frozen sparse-refresh schedule and test whether current hand plus two-bit age state predicts the next eviction and remaining horizon exactly without semantic information
